rationale: F5 (master review 2026-09-30): every function-valued Options option became a Method — `data` (isOptionsData), the lifecycle hooks (isLifecycleHook), `methods`, `computed`, `watch` — and `setup` was in none of them, although it is the function an Options component is built around. Measured: 20 element-plus files plus 1 vue-element-admin file write the Options `setup(props) { return { … } }` form and every one of them produced no symbol, so a graph of such a component had no entry point. `setup` is deliberately NOT added to `isLifecycleHook` — it is not a lifecycle hook, it is the composition entry point, and folding it into that predicate would make the predicate's name lie and blur `isLifecycleHook` for every other consumer — so it gets its own branch and its own `isSetup` marker. `mounted` is the CONTROL proving the neighbouring lifecycle branch still fires.
